messages:
mike: starting staged rollout v7.3.0 -> 10% to ap-southeast-1 (asia1). deploy-bot, kick the canary. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. watching 5xx and p95. tagging oncall @sara. threshold: 5xx >= +3% for 5m or p95 > 250ms => HOLD

deploy-bot: canary action started:
  - target: ap-southeast-1
  - traffic: 10%
  - version: v7.3.0
  - started_at: 1799998230
:rocket:

raj: grabbing dashboards. any special routes for asia1? i'll keep an eye on kv-cache evictions and pod restarts.

carol: release notes PR #456 updated. i'll append rollback steps and mitigations in a minute.

sara: oncall here, watching. ping me if you want a hard stop.

raj: small uptick at ~1799998280, 5xx +1.9% in asia1, p95 climbing. not at threshold yet. looking at logs.

mike: noted. if that reaches threshold, we'll hold and pin. hold = route asia1 back to v7.2.9 + scale down canary pods. rollback only after 5m sustained.

carol: logs show repeated kv-cache OOMs on 2/6 canary pods around 1799998295. snippet:
```
E 03:08:15 redis: eviction triggered, mem_used 98%, process restarted
E 03:08:16 app: cache miss flood, falling back to DB
```

nora: running quick smoke tests against v7.2.9 in asia1 now. will report in ~5m.

mike: this looks risky. issuing HOLD and PIN for asia1. @deploy-bot pin traffic to v7.2.9 and stop any increments. DO NOT promote to 25%.

deploy-bot: HOLD command received. executing pin and scale ops:
- pin: route asia1 -> v7.2.9
- scale: reduce canary pods for v7.3.0 to 2 for graceful drain
- estimated drain: ~3m

ops-bot: rollback runbook triggered: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback. note: draining may briefly increase latency.

sara: confirmed HOLD. will alert incidents channel if 5xx crosses 3% or p95 > 250ms after rollback. :eyes: 

raj: i bumped redis maxmemory and adjusted eviction policy on canary hosts, but since we pinned we'll monitor for side effects.

deploy-bot: pin complete at 1799998335. rollback in progress, posting final status when done.

nora: smoke eval v7.2.9 done: traces look good \u2705, sample p95 170ms, no new 5xx in the sample set.

carol: adding hold/rollback notes to PR #456 and scheduling a short postmortem after the change window.

mike: summary: HOLD + pin asia1 to v7.2.9, abort further percent increases. infra to investigate kv-cache memory patterns. re-run canary once mitigations validated. thanks. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: rollback finished at 1799998395. traffic restored to v7.2.9 in asia1. canary pods drained. logs: https://deploys.redwood/internal/1799998230

sara: monitoring, marking thread as "hold enacted". will reopen if signal resurfaces.

mike: will run postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. add timeline notes here before EOD.
